title: AI Training Data Curator Input
description: Crawl websites and export LLM training datasets for fine-tuning and RAG. Add URLs or a sitemap, set a page limit, download clean text as JSON, JSONL, or CSV.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Seed URLs to begin crawling. Required unless you provide sitemapUrl (at least one of the two must be set).

sitemapUrl.title: Sitemap URL
sitemapUrl.description: Optional sitemap.xml URL merged with startUrls. Required unless you provide at least one start URL.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch (HTTP requests). Filtered or duplicate pages still count toward this limit; saved dataset rows may be fewer.

maxSitemapUrls.title: Max sitemap URLs
maxSitemapUrls.description: Cap merged seed/sitemap URLs before crawling (defaults to maxPages)

minTextLength.title: Minimum text length
minTextLength.description: Minimum extracted text length in characters; shorter pages are filtered out.

language.title: Language filter
language.description: ISO 639-1 code (e.g. en). Leave empty to accept all.

deduplicate.title: Remove duplicates
deduplicate.description: When true, near-duplicate pages are removed using SimHash fingerprinting.

maxFingerprints.title: Max dedup fingerprints
maxFingerprints.description: Maximum SimHash fingerprints kept in memory (FIFO eviction when exceeded)

crawlStrategy.title: Crawl strategy
crawlStrategy.description: recurse: follow links from seed pages; seeds-only: crawl only seed/sitemap URLs

stayWithinDomain.title: Stay within seed domains
stayWithinDomain.description: When recursing, only follow links on seed hostnames

includeUrlGlobs.title: Include URL globs
includeUrlGlobs.description: Optional glob patterns; enqueued URLs must match at least one when set

excludeUrlGlobs.title: Exclude URL globs
excludeUrlGlobs.description: Optional glob patterns; matching URLs are never enqueued

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of pages fetched in parallel

minRequestDelaySecs.title: Min request delay (seconds)
minRequestDelaySecs.description: Minimum delay between requests for politeness (0 = no limit)

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: Maximum link hops from seed URLs (0 = seeds only). Leave empty for unlimited depth.

exportRejectedPages.title: Export rejected pages
exportRejectedPages.description: When true, URLs filtered out during processing are written to a separate 'rejected' dataset with filterReason

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings for blocked or geo-restricted sites
